changelog:
Initial release: Generates tailored UK and EU GDPR compliance documents for businesses.

- Provides implementation-ready templates for privacy policies, cookie policies, DPIAs, ROPA, DSAR responses, data breach notifications, and consent forms.
- Documents are customised to business type, data processing activities, and risk profile—avoids generic templates.
- Includes a built-in lawful basis matrix and clear reference to relevant UK/EU GDPR, DPA 2018, and PECR legal obligations.
- Includes information gathering prompts when user’s request lacks key details, ensuring documents are accurately tailored.
- Outputs always include a clear disclaimer recommending professional legal review.
